category_description: Buying a home in Canada: first-home programs, down payments and mortgages.
subcategory_description: Programs that help first-time buyers save for and buy a home.
label: Home Buyers' Plan withdrawal limit
context: The most that can be withdrawn from RRSPs in total under the Home Buyers' Plan. Any amount above it is reported as income.

label: Home Buyers' Plan repayment period
context: The period in which the amounts withdrawn have to be paid back into RRSPs.

label: Years after the first withdrawal before repayment starts (temporary relief)
context: Applies to a first withdrawal made from January 1 2022 to December 31 2028. The 15-year repayment period starts in the fifth year following the year of the first withdrawal.

subject_intro: How the Home Buyers' Plan lets first-time buyers withdraw from their RRSPs, who is eligible, how to withdraw, and how and when the money is paid back.
subject_meta_description: The Home Buyers' Plan lets you withdraw up to {fact:ca_hbp_limit} from your RRSPs to buy a first home. See who is eligible and how withdrawals and repayments work.
